meta.title: Model visibility
meta.description: Open Settings → Model visibility to organize the chat picker and inspect capability sources and token usage. Write-back requires explicit action; optional online verification may use model and search quota. Hiding a model does not disable its route. This final maintenance release keeps its original name and features. Protocol translation and separation of upstream thinking from reply text are planned at https://github.com/TZYCeng/DSH-The-Model-List.
